reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse a PAGE clause whose page limit integer-1 is less than integer-5, where integer-5 is the FOOTING integer if written, else the LAST DETAIL integer (GR2e), else integer-1 itself (GR2c), so a written FOOTING or (FOOTING omitted) a written LAST DETAIL above integer-1 must be refused.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel < 2002: the three-significant-digit bound of integer-1 (SR2), not this rule
ConstructRegistry ReportPageForms2002: refuses LAST CONTROL HEADING / DE / IS at 85, so the 1985 order set is HEADING, FIRST DETAIL, LAST DETAIL, FOOTING, page limit

reader.edition-search: The ordering loop in ScreenReportPageIntegers itself consults no edition (one arm for every edition); the edition sites on the path are the SR2 digit bound and the VersionConformancePass refusal of the 2002 phrases.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the comparison of the last written phrase to the page limit is the same code at 85 and 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1270 is only the legal side (FOOTING 9 < PAGE 12); the refusal, the GR2e default (LAST DETAIL above the limit with FOOTING omitted) and the equality boundary are not exercised

probes.printed: COBOL2744 the FOOTING integer 13 is greater than the page limit 12 (exit 65)
COBOL2744 the FOOTING integer 13 is greater than the page limit 12 (FOOTING alone)
COBOL2744 the LAST DETAIL integer 13 is greater than the page limit 12 (FOOTING omitted)
DONE (PAGE 999, LAST DETAIL 998, FOOTING 999: the 1985 largest integer-1 and equality)
DONE (HEADING 2 FIRST DETAIL 3, LAST DETAIL and FOOTING omitted)
COBOL0900 the LAST CONTROL HEADING phrase requires COBOL-2002

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR7  (3.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR7
OK  §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: The last written phrase of the sorted list is compared to the written page limit, which covers FOOTING > limit and, with FOOTING omitted, LAST DETAIL > limit (the GR2e default). Diagnostic cites §2023 only at --std 85 (citation blemish, not a defect).

refuter.evidence: Same member: the last written phrase is compared with the written page limit, covering FOOTING > limit and (FOOTING omitted, GR2e) LAST DETAIL > limit. Probes: r7 (HEADING 1 FIRST DETAIL 2 FOOTING +13 under PAGE 12) -> COBOL0001 '+' refused (signed integer not allowed at 85); r5 with the LIMITS ARE ... LINES spelling reaches the screen. The 9999 check precedes the 85 three-digit check by else-if, but both refuse. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR7 'Integer-1 must be greater than or equal to integer-5'.
